genericProblem: A successful seed exercises only a small, fixture-shaped subset of HTTP operations. Treating its database statement counts as the CRUD optimization denominator hides unmeasured route families and encourages removing correctness work rather than eliminating repeated owner-local reads, N+1 fan-out, and unnecessary write cycles.

counterexamples.reason: It covers 22 security operations, not the complete 26 anonymous routes or the 147-route HTTP denominator.
It proves 26 owner service call paths and 51 SQL cases, not every HTTP route; stable bulk task reads above three statements are not automatically N+1 defects.

counterexamples.surface: Workspace account, store-list and organization task-path reads
counterexamples.reason: They already use bounded IN/batch loading; a repeated method name or loop is not sufficient evidence of N+1.

counterexamples.surface: Commands with idempotency, CAS, audit, authorization recheck or owner readback
counterexamples.reason: Those facts remain required even when their JDBC count exceeds a list-read budget.
A single authorized-brand or asset lookup for one object is not list N+1.

findings.finding: The expanded root OpenAPI has 146 operations while the generated runtime registry has 147. The root omits the top-level reference for releasePlatformStagedAsset, although its path shard, controller, generated client and registry contain it. Existing edge-codegen --check therefore does not prove root-contract-to-runtime exact equality.

findings.surface: platform workspace page and operations head-company page
findings.finding: Two list routes perform true per-item owner calls: platform workspace list resolves each logo through PlatformAssetService.requireActivePublicReference; operations head-company list calls BusinessEntityService.authorizedBrands once per row, including an owner existence read.

accept, send OTP, verify OTP, save credentials and complete re-load the same invitation token through nested helpers. The safe repair is private owner-local reuse of one typed invitation load; rate limiting, CAS, audit and completion readback remain.

operations password login, OTP verify and session-entry paths can compose the same workspace session entry after an already successful session resolution/login. Canonical entry composition must remain inside workspace-iam rather than moving authorization facts into edge controllers.

Six create-handler families and definition replacement use a validate/read, write, then merge/re-read/update shape where canonical extension values and revision can be returned by a narrow extension owner API and written on the initial host insert. The API and its typed failures must reside in the extension declared command-api package.

Region and Project phase work is not uniformly shaped: Region still enters phase replacement and Project phase insertion is per-row update. The repair is owner-local node-type branching and a bounded batch write, retaining CAS, audit and Project readback.

Nine platform workspace/role/account mutations read a platform session and then independently re-read it to derive an actor. A single immutable PlatformSessionReadback may derive the edge actor; owner authorization/object-state rechecks remain mandatory.

Ten stable task-read source surfaces exceed the default three-statement guidance (including invitations, users, assignment candidates, overviews and session entry). The 100-item evidence indicates bounded bulk loading rather than N+1, so each requires an explicit task/read-model justification or an owner-local consolidation decision, not a mechanical ceiling.

Per-intent role and enterability decisions grow linearly. Current Seed is single-intent; multi-intent success, typed-failure and concurrency workloads are required before deciding whether a role-owner requireAll API is justified.

findings.surface: future all-route workload inventory and runner
findings.finding: A request template that declares credentials, OTPs, invitation tokens, cookies or authorization without an explicit in-memory secret flow can leak them through inventory, fixture receipt, logs, report, stderr or failure artifacts. Report-side redaction alone is insufficient.

Raw HTTP coverage/diagnostic execution and browser Journey L2 prove different things. Treating 147 HTTP calls as a browser L2 would add fixed frontend/Playwright cost without a user interaction oracle and misstate business evidence.

The extension module declares com.catering.v2s.extension.api as its command API package, yet six production locations directly use ExtensionDefinitionService.DefinitionNotFoundException from application: four cross-module consumers, ContractProblemAdvice and ExtensionAuditHistoryService. A new normalize API must publish its result and typed failures in api and include the full direct-reference migration denominator.

preventionDispositions.reason: A root OpenAPI expanded operation set and generated route registry exact-set comparison is mechanical, source-driven and has an immediate real red mutation.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: owner task-read tests plus 50-item page statement-count tests
preventionDispositions.reason: Only an exercised page cardinality distinguishes real N+1 from a legitimate single-object lookup.
Tests must preserve each typed failure, OTP/rate-limit behavior, CAS, audit and final readback while demonstrating the duplicate token load disappears.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: WorkspaceAuthenticationService and operations authentication controller tests
preventionDispositions.reason: A focused proof must show canonical owner composition for password, OTP and existing-session entry rather than only reduced statement count.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: module-dependency-registry commandApiPackages plus extension/host owner tests
preventionDispositions.reason: The repair is valid only when the typed validation/normalization result and failure are public extension-api types and the host owner performs its own insert.

preventionDispositions.owningSourceOrControl: organization owner tests for REGION, PROJECT and update phase variants
preventionDispositions.reason: The real red cases are node-type-specific phase behavior, not a generic statement threshold.
The proof must distinguish safe immutable edge context reuse from forbidden removal of owner rechecks.
Every above-default task read needs a declared bounded-data explanation, an owner/read-model rationale and a measured cardinality case; it is not a global hard gate.
No current multi-intent observation supports an implementation change; retain as an explicitly bounded research hypothesis.
Future diagnostic designs must declare secret origin, in-memory use, output exclusion, disposal and output-surface red proof before they name a workload scenario.
Every dynamic plan must name whether it is HTTP diagnostic integration, browser L2 or controlled performance study and state the evidence it cannot claim.

A public cross-owner API is closed only when its result and typed failures both reside in the owner declared commandApiPackages and every cross-owner, edge and owner-internal direct consumer is migrated or intentionally retired.
